g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: ProcureLake dev (ca-central-1): sources to Bronze, Silver, Gold and tenant products

g.title: None.None.Node.50
g.text: Writes to the RDS PostgreSQL 17 source are captured by logical replication (dev/cdc, disposable)
The DMS full-load-and-CDC task reads the source with credentials from Secrets Manager
DMS writes immutable Parquet change files to raw/bronze/postgres_cdc/ through the S3 gateway endpoint
Every 5 minutes, cdc_processing runs the apply job, then a dbt build of only the models downstream of the tables that changed
The apply-cdc Glue 5.1 job takes a DynamoDB lease, MERGEs changes into Silver Iceberg, then advances the checkpoint and queues the table for Gold
Daily, the batch ingestion machine runs a task-runner task that collects one settled USAspending day (or the Canada CSV) and writes the raw payload + manifest to Bronze
The reference-to-silver Glue job applies the new USAspending batches to Silver; rejects go to quarantine/
The bronze-to-silver Glue job applies the latest complete snapshot batch of the operational tables
The dbt runner (dbt-athena on ECS Fargate) builds the Gold Iceberg models and runs their tests on the engineering workgroup; started by the dbt state machine
Lake Formation row filters give each tenant only its own rows of the four tenant-facing marts
Each tenant queries through its own Athena workgroup; daily exports write each tenant's Parquet to the products bucket
When a document's landing manifest is written to the artifacts bucket, EventBridge starts one document intelligence execution
The extraction task (AI extraction role) calls Textract and Bedrock, validates the fields against the schema and queues the result in DynamoDB
A named reviewer approves or rejects each extraction (make ai-decide); only approved fields reach Silver, and dbt builds the Gold mart
